sql.sql: select d.*, p.brand_nm, p.molecule, p.co_flg from PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER d left join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT p on p.prod_ndc11=d.prod_ndc11 order by 1
select decile, spclty, count(*) n, count(distinct prscrbr_me) nd, sum(iff(prscrbr_me is null,1,0)) null_me from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER group by 1,2 order by 1,2
select min(call_dt), max(call_dt), count(*), count(distinct rep_id), count(distinct prscrbr_me), listagg(distinct call_typ, ',') from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT
select team, count(*), count(distinct rep_id) from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER group by 1

select (p.prscrbr_me is not null) matched, (r.rep_id is not null) rep_matched, r.team, count(*) calls, min(c.call_dt), max(c.call_dt), count(distinct c.prscrbr_me), max(length(c.prscrbr_me)), min(length(c.prscrbr_me))
from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT c left join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p on p.prscrbr_me=c.prscrbr_me left join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER r on r.rep_id=c.rep_id group by 1,2,3

select min(wk_end_dt), max(wk_end_dt), count(distinct wk_end_dt), count(distinct prod_ndc11), count(distinct prscrbr_me), sum(iff(prod_ndc11 in (select prod_ndc11 from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT),0,1)) unmatched_ndc, max(length(prod_ndc11)), min(length(prod_ndc11)), sum(iff(prscrbr_me in (select prscrbr_me from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER),0,1)) unmatched_me from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY

select p.decile, count(*), avg(de_trx), min(de_trx), max(de_trx), avg(gl_trx), min(gl_trx), max(gl_trx) from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p left join rx on rx.prscrbr_me=p.prscrbr_me group by 1 order by 1

select table_schema, table_name, column_name, comment from PHARMA_DEMO.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where table_schema<>'INFORMATION_SCHEMA' and (column_name ilike any ('%OPT%','%PDRP%','%RESTR%','%CONTACT%','%DNC%','%FLAG%','%FLG%','%DECILE%','%STATUS%','%ACTIVE%') or comment is not null) order by 1,2

from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p left join c on c.prscrbr_me=p.prscrbr_me left join rx on rx.prscrbr_me=p.prscrbr_me left join pl on pl.prscrbr_me=p.prscrbr_me
left join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.TERRITORY t on t.terr_id=p.terr_id left join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.ACCOUNT a on a.account_id=p.account_id
where p.decile>=8 and coalesce(c.calls_90d,0)=0 order by p.decile desc, de_trx_13w desc
